scenarios.reason: AP determined agent is stuck — no viable actions remain
scenarios.diagnosis: The local test setup sent the sign-in request to GitHub with the client ID set to "undefined". GitHub therefore showed its own sign-in page instead of returning the user to Proofed, leaving no way to check the requested dashboard behavior.
scenarios.suggestion: Configure a valid GitHub OAuth client ID and callback credentials for the deployed/local Worker test environment, then rerun the browser check from sign-in.
